# Abs Image Filter

Computes the absolute value of each pixel.

## Group (Subgroup)

ImageProcessing (Pointwise)

## Description

Computes `abs(x)` for every pixel. ITK-free, out-of-core-capable reimplementation of the legacy ITK Abs Image Filter.
